page.overview:
What is Uwazumi High School?

Uwazumi High School is a high school located in the city of in . It is the primary setting of One Piece in Love.

thumb|One of the Pirate Club's recruitment flyers, based on the flyers by the Fake Straw Hat Crew. The is a One Piece-themed school club founded by Nakatsugawa Usopp. While it was initially an official club, it was disbanded by the student council due to Brook's dirty voice lines, with its status now unclear.
